source: I... found it. I possess the Book of Fates. So many pieces had to be moved in order for me to find it, but it now sits on my table. The book itself does not provide one exit, but many - and it seems Quince is far from who I thought he was.
target: 我……找到它了。《命运之书》已经在我手里。为了找到它，我不得不改变许多事情，但现在，它就在我的桌上。这本书提供的出路不止一条，而是许多条——看来，昆斯也远不是我以为的那个人。

source: He lied to me. He's not on my side at all. He desires nothing more than my total and complete destruction, as some kind of sick game—some source of entertainment for him. I cannot give him that satisfaction. I must push onward. I have the Book of Fates to guide me.
target: 他骗了我。他根本不站在我这一边。他一心只想让我彻底毁灭，把这当成某种病态的游戏——供他取乐。我不能让他如愿。我必须继续走下去。我有《命运之书》指引我。

source: (I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever, if I wanted to.)
target: （只要我愿意，就可以用《命运之书》永远保留这个世界。）

source: I could use the Book of Fates to embrace madness, if I wanted to.
target: 如果我愿意，我可以用《命运之书》拥抱疯狂。

source: (I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever.)
target: （我可以用《命运之书》，永远保留这个世界。）

source: (The Book of Fates will make this reality, if I really want it...)
target: （如果我真的想要，《命运之书》就会让这一切成为现实……）

source: (But I could use the Book of Fates to keep this world forever, and to become Queen. Just like Simona before me.)
target: （但我可以用《命运之书》永远保留这个世界，成为王后。就像在我之前的西蒙娜一样。）

target: 没错。《命运之书》甚至能让这样的奇迹短暂地成为现实。

source: When we last left Ophelia, she was ready to use the Book of Fates to elope with Othello the barkeep.

target: 因为只要你使用《命运之书》……它就会立刻回到我手里！

target: 我可以用《命运之书》永远保留这个世界，去看看埃尔西诺城墙之外的天地。

source: You've already witnessed a small amount of the power the Book of Fates can bestow.

source: The Book of Fates, of course, saved you from death and chose you to be my unwilling partner in this game.
